text: Stennis Bank financed the Garrow Heights housing scheme, according to a loan schedule filed with the Ministry of Civic Works and reviewed by The Continental Record. The document, dated 14 May 2025, shows the bank extending a 38.4 million crown facility to Garrow Heights Development Co. for the first phase of the 612-unit project on the north side of Rillam. A ministry official confirmed the filing number and said the loan was registered before ground was broken in June. Company records name Stennis Bank as sole senior lender, with disbursements tied to completion milestones and a reserve account for infrastructure overruns.
